basic_profile.bio: Greetings! I'm a long-time gamer based in Austin, Texas, with a passion for modding and trading virtual cars. By day, I work as a software developer specializing in game design, and by night, I'm a dedicated car modder in the world of GTA. My interests span across all things gaming, especially in the modding community, and I enjoy sharing my creations with others. I also have a keen interest in the latest music trends and love discovering new tunes. Typically online during late evenings, I'm happily single and enjoy the independence that comes with it.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been involved in the gaming industry for over a decade. My expertise in modding comes from years of experimentation and collaboration with fellow enthusiasts. I've developed a keen understanding of game mechanics and modding tools through both professional experience and self-directed projects.
